historical.reason: A session-19 Linux device-lane capture, deliberately kept and deliberately NOT re-taken. Eight commits have touched rust/src, rust/shaders and the proof ledger since it was produced, so it is genuinely stale and the list above is correct. I attempted the re-take on 2026-08-04 in the same WSL Ubuntu image that produced it: the EP builds and links (libonnxruntime_vulkan_ep.so sha256 68fe9461...), lavapipe is still installed, and onnxruntime 1.28.0 imports — but the ops suite now collects a different population and reports 62 failed / 463 passed / 341 skipped in 191s against this reading’s 9 failed / 676 passed / 50 skipped in 1371s. 341 skips where there were 50 means the device tests are not running at all, so the environment no longer reproduces the lane. Re-stamping a frame over a run that different would be a worse lie than the staleness: the frame would claim a current reading and carry a run that answered another question. So the age is declared rather than papered over, and it is printed on every run.
